asked.item: Same customer messaged two Facebook Pages and we replied on each: counts once or twice?
People who only comment and never get a reply: do they count?

verdict.reason: Both questions are answered directly by the active-contacts sentences on the Billing & Credits page.

steps.text: If the same person interacts with two connected Facebook Pages, they count as two active contacts.
Someone who messages or comments on your posts does not count until you reply.
